responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain robust data models to support analytical and product data needs across the organization
Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into scalable data solutions
Implement and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ensure data quality, reliability, and performance
Own and define business KPIs, their measurement plans, data requirements and reporting
Build processes to ensure correct, timely and reliable reporting
Address ad-hoc reporting requirements and find pathways for automation
Build and enforce common design patterns to increase report reusability, readability and standardization
Build visually appealing, high-performing, and impactful reporting/dashboard products using tools like Sigma/Thoughtspot/Looker across large data sets

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build processes to ensure correct, timely and reliable reporting
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour: the duties stress data quality, reliability and correct reporting; 'fast paced environment' appears once in the requirements and 'move quickly' only in company boilerplate.
evidence.domain_risk: reporting, product analytics, marketing optimization and financial reporting
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Moderate: a delivery marketplace; financial reporting is named only as one of the wider data team's use cases, not as this role's focus.
evidence.data_team_maturity: The Data Engineering team builds database solutions for various use cases
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Mature: an established data engineering team serves many use cases, and the role builds self-service analytics across a large organisation.
evidence.jd_authorship: using tools like Sigma/Thoughtspot/Looker across large data sets
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Mixed: some duties name tools and outputs, while others are generic ('Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders').
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: developing a reliable semantic/presentation layer and reporting structure that meets our growing business needs, enabling teams to access and analyze data independently
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Internal data: the role builds the semantic layer and self-service reporting that other teams consume.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Mixed: the role owns KPI definitions and design patterns while also handling ad-hoc reporting requests.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Only general familiarity with machine learning concepts is a nice-to-have; no AI skill is expected.
evidence.testing_framing: Implement and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ensure data quality, reliability, and performance
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Responsibility: ensuring data quality and correct reporting are framed as duties, though no testing tool is named.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Build processes to ensure correct, timely and reliable reporting
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Moderate: reliability of reporting is a concern, but the posting is framed mainly around building and scaling.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: build and scale data models, pipelines, and self-service analytics
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Fix/scale: the role scales existing data models and reporting to meet 'growing business needs'.
evidence.loss_aversion: Implement and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ensure data quality, reliability, and performance
